expected_outcomes: Client behavior, state, rendering, accessibility, performance, telemetry, and recovery are explicit and tested.
required_actions: Separate local UI state from server state and implement complete platform-appropriate states.
expected_documents: Client architecture note, state matrix, accessibility plan, performance budget, and test plan.
acceptance: State behavior matches approved contracts and errors provide recovery without sensitive details.
verification: Run unit, component, integration, accessibility, performance, device, and end-to-end tests according to risk.
evidence: Test output, performance measurements, accessibility results, and known limitations.
failure_conditions: Client duplicates server-authoritative rules, exposes inaccessible controls, or presents stale state as current.
exceptions: Document unsupported platform, user impact, compensating behavior, owner, and removal plan.
